CORRECTION_r534: As first run, gate 4 tested only the MAGNITUDE of each arm's displacement from control and reported PASS for the weakness arm, with a hard-coded remark claiming that arm was not displaced. Both statements were wrong. The weakness arm IS displaced, by 0.430 deg, which is 12 times this endpoint's own artefact floor of 0.0358 deg -- a floor 16 times smaller than knee-at-contact's 0.586 deg, which is why an absolute displacement that looks negligible clears it. What the gate failed to test is the SIGN. Both arms sit on the same side of control, 21 times apart in size. The endpoint therefore grades the severity of the equinus and cannot say which lesion produced it. SWEEP_r532 scores the sign and is the convention.
